visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: One Pass with Two Pointers
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The list is walked once to count its nodes and a second time to walk half the count. Find the middle in a single pass with a slow and a fast pointer. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Two pointers find the middle in one pass without counting first. This slow and fast pointer idea also detects cycles in a list.
